NEW TO THE SPORT?

SAME DRIVE.
DIFFERENT FORMATS.

Football and baseball divide schools into classes based on enrollment. FTC and FRC describe different robotics competition formats instead. FIRST does not assign these programs by school enrollment: a school can offer either, or both.

Meet your local robotics community ↗
01 / FTC

COMPACT ROBOTS.
BIG POSSIBILITIES.

FIRST Tech Challenge often has smaller teams working with compact robots. Students build, code, drive, and develop a strategy for their own game and championships.

GRADES 7–12 · COMPACT-ROBOT FORMAT
02 / FRC

LARGER ROBOTS.
A FULL-TEAM EFFORT.

FIRST Robotics Competition often involves larger programs building industrial-sized robots. Students bring engineering, software, business, and teamwork to their own game and championships.

GRADES 9–12 · LARGER-ROBOT FORMAT

Like different sports, their scoring systems differ. FTC OPR and FRC EPA are presented separately. Both programs compete, collaborate, and build career skills.
